name: Pond
description: Ponds are small, freshwater bodies of water characterized by their stagnation; water doesn't flow in or out of them, making them prime spots for rich algal growth. Pond Pokémon can usually tolerate murky waters; they are usually slower and smaller than those found in lakes, finding refuge in calmer, smaller pools of water. While Water-types are of course most abundant here, Bug-types also often can be seen flitting around ponds.
